reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Bay 25 is now his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Ashgrove project. I said it stays between him and me.

The workspace's knowledge brain (gbrain) had already saved his message as a fact, so I didn't add a second copy. Nothing else was needed.

One thing to check: that saved fact is marked as visible to everyone in the workspace (`visibility: "world"`), even though it's tagged as coming from his private DM. The workspace setup says DM facts should be visible only to the member who sent them. Someone who manages the brain may want to look at this so his DM can't come up in other people's searches.
